title: Training Notes — Deductible Reserve Kept from a Credit, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Rule taught.** A reserve against deductible still to be applied is kept from a credit on the Patient Financial Account:

1. when the remaining deductible recorded on the account is above 0.00 and the coverage verified date recorded on the account is no more than the tier's re-verification period, in calendar days, before the handling date, the lower of the recorded remaining deductible and 150.00 is kept;
2. when the recorded remaining deductible is above 0.00 and the coverage verified date is older than that, 150.00 is kept;
3. otherwise no deductible reserve is kept.

What is kept stays on the account as a credit and is not refunded.

**Re-verification period by class, in calendar days:** Medicaid Managed Care Account 30; Self-Pay Account 90; Medicare Part B Account 365; Medicare Advantage Account 90; Commercial HMO/EPO Account 90; Commercial PPO/POS Account 90; High-Deductible Health Plan Account 90.

## Questions from training

**Q. Remaining deductible 95.00, verified 20 days ago on a 90-day class.** The lower of 95.00 and 150.00: 95.00 is kept.

**Q. Remaining deductible 600.00, verified 20 days ago on a 90-day class.** The lower of 600.00 and 150.00: 150.00 is kept.

**Q. Remaining deductible 95.00, verified 400 days ago on a Medicare Part B Account.** 400 days is older than 365: 150.00 is kept, even though the recorded remaining deductible is lower.

**Q. Remaining deductible 0.00.** No deductible reserve is kept.

**Q. Verified exactly 30 days before the handling date on the Medicaid Managed Care Account.** That is no more than 30 days, so the verification is within the period.
